dosepi.name: DosePI: Extensive Dataset for Peristaltic Pump Accuracy Enhancement
dosepi.purpose: Pump delivery accuracy, dosing variation, compensation modelling, pump output behaviour.
dosepi.type: Pharmaceutical peristaltic filling pump dataset (not clinical intravenous continuous infusion).

pressure_occlusion.name: Multi-infusion with integrated multiple pressure sensing allows earlier detection of line occlusions
pressure_occlusion.purpose: Pressure behaviour, normal infusion patterns, genuine occlusion events, pressure anomaly analysis.
pressure_occlusion.type: In vitro multi-infusion clinical pressure-event research study.

force_failure.name: Development of a Real-time Force-based Algorithm for Infusion Failure Detection
force_failure.purpose: Pressure and force relationships, infusion failure classification, cross-sensor consistency analysis.
force_failure.type: In vitro force and line-pressure experimental failure study.

smart_pump_logs.name: Hospitals Infusion Data Set: Spain (Determinants of Intravenous Infusion Longevity and Infusion Failure)
smart_pump_logs.purpose: Infusion operating conditions, pump event information, occlusion and infusion termination context.
smart_pump_logs.type: Retrospective hospital smart pump event logs (operational discrete events, not continuous raw waveforms).

sensor_defects.name: Typical Sensor Defects Dataset
sensor_defects.purpose: Sensor drift, offset, noise, peaks and abnormal sensor behaviour benchmark.
sensor_defects.type: Generic multi-sensor defect benchmark dataset (hazardous material storage container, not an infusion pump).
